notes: New card, authored from real Scryfall oracle text (data/fin/... not applicable — this is a non-FIN deck-import card, Scryfall data fetched live). Once-per-turn cap on the draw trigger not tracked (no per-turn trigger-count state in this model). Activated ability's 'up to two other nonland permanents' modeled via custom (no declarative move filter for 'nonland'). 2026-09-05 user review pass: (1) `drawCard` re-declared as a real produce fact (promoted off SYNERGY_DESIGN.md's parked list — verify-synergy.mjs's `producedEvent`/`explainableFns` now handle it), was wrongly dropped as unsupported in the first pass; (2) sourceText on both the produce and the activateAbility want now states the once-per-turn cap explicitly; (3) the custom effect now exiles both chosen targets, then returns both, instead of interleaving exile+return per target — matches the real card's own two-step batch structure. (4) the exile/return activation now declares its own produces (zone:Exile, zone:Battlefield, event:entersBattlefield) — previously only a want existed, so the trace's own moveTo Exile/Battlefield actions had no matching produce (soft notes). entersBattlefield is a new produce kind (verify-synergy.mjs's producedEvent gained a moveTo->Battlefield case, a real pool-wide MTG rule, not Elrond-specific) recognizing that returning permanents re-triggers their own ETB abilities — a real blink effect other cards' entersBattlefield wants (loporrit-scout, woodland-weavemaster) can now match against. (5) the 'return at the beginning of the next end step' delay is now a REAL delayed trigger, not an immediate simplification: added `actions.delayUntil(phase, run)` (functional-model/interfaces.ts/card.ts), `GameState.scheduleDelayedTrigger`/`delayedTriggers` (state.ts), and phase-entry draining in `turn.ts`'s `advancePhase` — a real, pool-wide engine primitive, not Elrond-specific. This card's own activation scenario now sets `advanceToPhase: 'EndOfTurn'` and the trace genuinely shows the return firing only once the game reaches EndOfTurn, not right after the exile. Dion, Bahamut's Dominant's own exile-then-return (a SELF-transform, not a delayed return of other permanents) was left as its existing immediate simplification — out of scope for this pass. (6) `strength` values hand-tuned per fact (5/2/2/2/3/4) as a deliberate mix of real magnitude and ease-of-triggering (drawCard=5 since it's the card's real payoff; the two zone/event produces from the exile/return=2, a slower, costlier ability; activateAbility want=3, lower than the zone want's 4 specifically BECAUSE it's conditional on a Creature target — the constraint is no longer shown in describeFact()'s label, this is where that nuance now lives instead) — NOT re-derivable by `compute-weights.mjs` (which would overwrite these back to raw trace-magnitude numbers, all ~1); do not re-run compute-weights.mjs for this card without re-applying these values, until a real ease+strength scoring system replaces this manual pass.
knownGaps: Once-per-turn cap on the draw-per-activation trigger is not enforced (no per-turn trigger-count tracking anywhere in this model).
